text: Hate your voice on recordings? Bad news. That's the real you.
Try this. Plug your ears and hum. Hear how loud it gets?
That's because you hear yourself two ways at once.
One, through the air, into your ears. Just like everyone else.
Two, through your skull. Your bones vibrate and carry the sound straight inside.
Bone passes the low notes best. So in your head, you sound deeper and richer.
A microphone has no skull. It only catches the air part.
So the thin voice on the recording? That's the one your friends hear. Every day.
And the deep voice in your head? Only you have ever heard it.
Do you hate your recorded voice? Comment yes or no.
